The sampler uses an independent deterministic RNG stream so it cannot alter the main Aeon power simulation.
Probabilities use all sampled sequences as denominator; a sequence with no access inside the horizon remains a miss.

notes: Table Friction is descriptive, not moralized: signals describe table-relevant characteristics rather than good/bad behavior.
V1 intentionally omits deterministic-loop classification until combo evidence contains reliable loop/prerequisite metadata.
Goldfish Horizon is a temporal access profile, not a win-probability curve.
V2 prefers true cumulative P(first access ≤ turn) curves from an independent deterministic sub-sample while preserving the historical on-turn curves in availabilityCurves.
